about: Reviewed GitHub Action pins (backend#421) and container images (backend#426). check-action-pins approves a remote uses: only when its owner/repo (case-insensitive), version comment (exactly the tag) and SHA (exactly) are one entry of pins; a path after owner/repo must be listed in paths. A SHA alone is not provenance: GitHub resolves fork-network commits under the upstream name. Add or bump an entry with `node bin/check-action-pins.mjs --resolve owner/repo@tag` in a ci-scripts PR; CI runs --verify-lock, which requires each tag to resolve upstream to exactly its sha. Every image a workflow pulls - docker://, an action's runs.image, a job's container and a service's image - must likewise be one entry of images, matched by name and digest, because a digest proves only that the bytes cannot change, not that they were reviewed or came from where you think. images is empty because no workflow in these repositories runs a container image today; add one in a ci-scripts PR, recording in method how the digest was obtained.
